title: Cliffnotes: Way overpriced, cheap toys,  cute theme
text: Disclaimer I bought this as a deal of the day so paid half price and it wasn't worth it at that price.  I would never pay full price.  .  I bough the multicat subscription.  The theme of the box was cute.  It was safari themed and the toys met the theme.  Most of the toys however were something that you would buy for 2 to 3 dollars each.  The feather toy ( the favorite) was destroyed in two days.  The other toys have pretty much been ignored by the two cats.  While they fit the theme there wasn't really any variation in the toys from how the cat would play with them.  I recommend going and picking out toys for your kitties yourself.  The treat in our box was a "kitty champagne"  We are waiting for a special occasion to give it to them.
label: negative
